_doc: Perf-loop iterations charted by scripts/perf/render_history.py. Runs are matched to an iteration by label prefix (itN-) or by the listed baseline labels; only 8-loadgen, 50 ms-round runs are charted.

iterations.name: Reachability
iterations.change: Indirect rule asks reachability instead of building and sorting the full causal history

iterations.name: Skip committed
iterations.change: Commit walk skips slots whose leader certificate is already committed

iterations.name: One search
iterations.change: Indirect rule: one multi-source search over all directly decided anchors

iterations.name: Descendants
iterations.change: Upward descendant scan for the walk; slower, reverted

iterations.name: Commit walker
iterations.change: One task runs commit walks, woken through a coalescing Notify instead of a walk per certificate and vote

iterations.name: Direct memo
iterations.change: Per-walk memo of direct decisions keyed by DAG version; no measurable gain, reverted

iterations.name: Leader wait
iterations.change: Round driver waits up to one extra tick for the previous leader's certificate; removes late flips and the multi-second tail

iterations.name: Keyed sort
iterations.change: Causal histories sorted on precomputed (round, author, hash) keys instead of two map lookups per comparison

iterations.name: RPC index prune
iterations.change: Explorer indices pruned a quarter window at a time instead of on every gc advance; prune_state left the profile, total gain within noise
